title: Changing plans while keeping things fair
meaning: Your union can keep its balance through change when attentive action rests on a fair sharing of responsibility.
text: The overall tone of your union may be attentive to circumstances and sensitive to change. In the physical position, the High Priestess holds back a hurried step: you want to understand what remains behind the words before intervening. In energy, Justice encourages honesty, attention to consequences and a fair division of responsibility. In emotions, the Wheel of Fortune describes the experience of changing phases. What felt stable yesterday feels different today, and shared life needs room for turns that your will cannot completely control.

Suppose a change to working hours disrupts your familiar evening together. You first establish the new conditions, then divide household tasks again so that the disruption does not fall entirely on one person. Gradually, the unexpected timetable starts revealing other opportunities to meet. **A fair agreement helps you stay connected when the familiar rhythm changes.** You need not welcome every change equally. What matters is that you can each name both what has become easier and what you miss.

The difficulty begins if every turn feels like a violation of a fair arrangement. You want someone to be responsible for changed circumstances and try to restore the exact earlier balance. Attention becomes a search for hidden mistakes, while discussion turns into an argument over debts. Protecting fairness, you demand an unchanging world. A new measure of participation can still be fair without resembling the old one.
